simple.summary: אָוָה (ʼâvâh) means to extend or mark out First listed occurrence: Num 34 10.

definitions.full: H184. avah II. [ אָוָה ] verb sign, mark, describe with a mark (so Ges (who compares תוה תאה, ) Dl Pr 116 ( not W)) only Hithpa`el Perfect לָכֶם הִתְאַוִּיתֶם mark you out, measure , Num 34:10 (P), so Vrss (compare לָכֶם תְּתָאוּ 34:7 ; 34:8 ; see however Di, & below I. אוה ).
